description: This file is a shell script containing test cases and setup commands for testing the output formats of a Git fetch operation under various configurations and scenarios. It includes cloning repositories, configuring fetch output formats, executing fetch commands with different options, and verifying the output against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, executing the provided shell commands and verifying their success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets actions to run after the test, such as cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail; the test passes if the command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists within a file's contents.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
